# Emoji asset attribution

Selected 16×16 and 64×64 PNG arrays in `src/emoji_assets.h` are copied unchanged
from [LGFX_Fonts](https://github.com/tobozo/LGFX_Fonts), commit
`253cf549fe0b1aa932be68fe06a13c3077918d61`, from
`src/Fonts/emojis/{16x16,64x64}/emojis_data_*.h`.

These are the Noto emoji assets used in LovyanGFX's official emoji example.
Copyright 2018 The Noto Project Authors, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL.txt).
The upstream LGFX_Fonts package notice is retained in LGFX_Fonts-LICENSE.txt.
Only selected PNG arrays are embedded; no external font runtime is required.
